# Virgulas

> Virgulas is a local-first browser outliner. Your outline lives in your browser
> (Memory, Local, or a user-chosen `.vmd` file) or in your own encrypted Supabase
> row in Remote mode. Encryption happens on the device; the server only ever holds
> ciphertext it cannot read.

Virgulas follows [The Website Specification](https://specification.website).

## Pages

- [Virgulas](https://virgulas.com/): the single-page outliner application.
- [Privacy](https://virgulas.com/privacy.html): what data is stored, where, and why.
- [Source (GitHub)](https://github.com/pitermarx/Virgulas): MIT-licensed codebase.

## Plain-text formats

- The in-app tour is an outline in the VMD format: <https://virgulas.com/intro.vmd>.
- The format is documented in the repository at <https://github.com/pitermarx/Virgulas/blob/main/docs/VMD.md>.

## Notes for agents

- The app is client-rendered; the initial HTML is an app shell. Structured facts
  about the product are in the JSON-LD `SoftwareApplication` block on the home page.
- `robots.txt` allows search and AI-input (grounding) use and reserves the right to
  object to model training (`Content-Signal: ai-train=no`).
